items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: I think the 400 is open with Teddy Buckner. I think Teddy Buckner is back there.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's what I hear. They closed.

And, uh, I think Joe Darinsburg is playing at some other place that this fellow opened up. It says quite a small place. It's not as big as the Beverly cabin, but, uh, they seem to be doing pretty good. The 400 is not open. Like they said, no, I think the 400 is open with Teddy Buckner. I think Teddy Buckner is back there. So, uh, I don't know what's what I, I haven't been writing out there for quite a while. Was a friend of ours, one of our fans I write to all the time. She always let me know, send me clippings…
About a hundred and twenty dollars a piece for a railroad fare.
